# What Argus knows

Generated from the lessons an admin approved on /admin/lessons. Do not edit: the next change rewrites this file.

## Deploy lock waits for the previous pipeline

_develop, change_ · lesson 7

Cancel the older pipeline when the deploy lock waits.

## Metrics exporter scrapes every 30 seconds

_general_ · lesson 6

The exporter interval is 30 s; a 15 s scrape gets stale data.

## Billing API health check listens on port 8082

_group-a/billing-api, develop_ · lesson 4

Since the last release the health check is on 8082.

## Queue worker needs the cache before start

_group-b/queue-worker, pre-release, general_ · lesson 2

Start the cache first, then the worker; the other order loops.

## Edge proxy: reload, never restart

_group-c/edge-proxy, release, production_ · lesson 3

Reload the edge proxy during the day.

A restart drops every connection.

The health check is on 8081, not 8080.
Check with curl -fsS :8081/health.

db.title: Queue worker needs the cache before start
db.body: Start the cache first, then the worker; the other order loops.

db.title: Edge proxy: reload, never restart
db.body:
Reload the edge proxy during the day.

A restart drops every connection.

db.title: Billing API health check listens on port 8082
db.body: Since the last release the health check is on 8082.

db.title: Billing API health check listens on port 8083
db.body: Another one while the update waits.

db.title: Metrics exporter scrapes every 30 seconds
db.body: The exporter interval is 30 s; a 15 s scrape gets stale data.

db.title: Deploy lock waits for the previous pipeline
db.body: Cancel the older pipeline when the deploy lock waits.

db.title: Cache warm-up takes two minutes
db.body: Wait two minutes after the cache starts before the worker check.
